actions.name: Abyssal Tether

cost.trigger: The user hits with and resolves and Physical- or Special-Category Dark Type Attack against a target.

actions.description:
Trigger: The user hits a creature with a Physical- or Special-Category Dark Type Attack.

Effect: The target is @Affliction[bound 7]. While @Affliction[bound], the target is @Affliction[stunted] and @Affliction[stuck], and has -1 default ATK and SPATK. This @Affliction[bound] effect can be removed with a Difficult Acrobatics or Lift Skill Check taken as a Simple Action.
